intro_text: p_l stumbles across a rotting, withered patch of herbs. It smells sick in a way that {PRONOUN/p_l/subject}{VERB/p_l/'ve/'s} never smelled before.
decline_text: p_l turns away from the mysterious herbs. {PRONOUN/p_l/subject/CAP} {VERB/p_l/don't/doesn't} want to risk bringing some foreign disease into camp.

success_outcomes.text: p_l picks a single leaf to carry back to camp. Clearly, these herbs won't be any good, but whatever has begun destroying them should be brought back home and studied.
p_l watches in silence as a small rabbit hops up to the herb patch, begins to nibble, and collapses after a few moments. Whatever this herb sickness is, it does the opposite of healing!

fail_outcomes.text: p_l leans in to sniff the sick herbs. However, when {PRONOUN/p_l/subject} {VERB/p_l/get/gets} close, a cluster of black spores is shaken from one of the leaves and p_l has the displeasure of accidentally inhaling it. {PRONOUN/p_l/subject/CAP} {VERB/p_l/return/returns} to camp with an awful headache.

p_l tries to approach the herbs, but the rotten scent is too strong for {PRONOUN/p_l/object} to get very close. {PRONOUN/p_l/subject/CAP} {VERB/p_l/return/returns} to camp to check {PRONOUN/p_l/poss} own herb stores for the strange disease.
